source.name: Metropolitan Football Stadium District: "Empower Field at Mile High" Name Change
source.quote: Today the Metropolitan Football Stadium District (MFSD) entered into a twenty-one year Naming Rights Agreement with Empower Retirement to name the home of the Denver Broncos

note: Arena naming rights: Empower Field at Mile High. Announced 2019-09-06, a twenty-one year agreement; the release says Empower Retirement will pay an average of $3 million annually, so the value is the reported annual average.
